name: Solo Silo: Conventional Rockets
description: Embedded single-round launch silo, laser designator and a fast conventional cruise missile, with custom meshes, custom smoke/fire VFX and original sounds (no vanilla particles, explosions or sounds). Models: "BGM-109 Tomahawk missile" by RickSlash, "Vertical Launch System Missile Canisters" by DenisGLabrecque, "Zenitco Perst 4 laser pointer" by ikoval31 (all CC BY 4.0, modified). Game physics, not a weapon simulation.
